evidence.why_not_priced: It mostly is priced. A company that beats its guide 3 for 3 has taught holders to expect a beat, and the damped reactions show it: if the market had not expected a beat, the last three beats would have moved the stock clearly up. The only part that may not be priced is the size of the Q2 cinema pick-up that Barco reported after MITQ last spoke. That is sized small because the reaction function has not paid for this line.
